bench.description: IPC for the bench plugin (benchmark harness, Benchmark this PC, autotuner) in the main window.

caption-window.description: IPC for the caption-window plugin (always-on-top, click-through caption window, P6-B) in the main window. The caption window's own rights are captions.json.

captions.description: The caption window (label 'captions', P6-B): it only listens to events (captions from the main window) and can be dragged when click-through is off. No plugin commands, no file system, no window creation.

diagnostics.description: IPC for the diagnostics plugin (EP outcomes, EP probe, file log, NVIDIA runtime pack) in the main window.

edge-tts.description: IPC for the edge-tts plugin (Microsoft Edge Read-aloud voices into the TTS sink, P6-H) in the main window.

gemini-tts.description: IPC for the gemini-tts plugin (Google Gemini TTS into the TTS sink; key in a header only, P6-H) in the main window.

google-fonts.description: IPC for the google-fonts plugin (Google Fonts family list fetched with the API key kept in Rust) in the main window.

gpt-sovits.description: IPC for the gpt-sovits plugin (GPT-SoVITS api_v2 client into the TTS sink, P6-G) in the main window.

llm-server.description: IPC for the llm-server plugin (bundled llama-server helper and the OpenAI-compatible HTTP proxy) in the main window.

local-tts.description: IPC for the local-tts plugin (in-process Kokoro / Piper / Kitten TTS) in the main window.

migrated.description: permissions that were migrated from v1

model-store.description: IPC for the model-store plugin (catalog, downloads, install, import, disk usage) in the main window.

mt-local.description: IPC for the mt-local plugin (NLLB-200 on ONNX Runtime and the Bergamot helper) in the main window.

oauth-token.description: IPC for the oauth-token plugin (Kick / Twitch OAuth token exchange and refresh with the client secret kept in Rust) in the main window.

openai-speech.description: IPC for the openai-speech plugin (OpenAI-compatible streaming TTS client) in the main window.

process-host.description: IPC for the process-host plugin (helper processes bound to 127.0.0.1) in the main window.

resources.description: IPC for the resources plugin (VRAM budget, claims and model recommendations) in the main window.

runtime.description: IPC for the runtime plugin (native runtime packs and sigil_engine DLLs) in the main window.

speech.description: IPC for the speech plugin (STT pipelines: start / stop / status, retained utterance audio, route preview) in the main window.

sysinfo.description: IPC for the sysinfo plugin (GPU, driver, CPU and execution-provider eligibility probe) in the main window.

text-readings.description: IPC for the text-readings plugin (Japanese hiragana / romaji and Chinese pinyin readings of captions, P6-L) in the main window.

tts-helpers.description: IPC for the tts-helpers plugin (helper-process TTS engines under process_host: Qwen3-TTS, Style-Bert-VITS2 / AIVMX and the experimental ggml engines, P6-E/F/G) in the main window.

tts-sink.description: IPC for the tts-sink plugin (unified TTS audio sink: utterance queue, binary PCM push, cancel / flush, status) in the main window.

voice-library.description: IPC for the voice-library plugin (shared reference-voice recorder and library for zero-shot voice conversion and TTS cloning) in the main window.

vr-overlay.description: IPC for the vr-overlay plugin (SteamVR caption overlay through a lazily loaded openvr_api.dll, P6-B) in the main window.
